name: Moto Rider VR: Highway Bike Racing
summary: VR motorcycle racing on Meta Quest. Weave through dense highway traffic — dodge cars, buses & trucks, chain near-miss bonuses, and chase high scores at extreme speeds. Race across desert, snow & jungle highways in stunning first-person VR. Master 4 modes: One-Way, Two-Way, Time Trial & Free Ride. Unlock multiple powerful bikes with smooth, realistic controls. An intense VR bike racing and highway traffic rider experience on Meta Horizon. Strap on your headset — the highway won't wait.
